name: app-red-problem-solution-columns-with-stripe-and-block-visuals
title: Red Problem and Solution Columns
whatItIs: A dark red vignette slide with a headline about turning pain points into solutions and four columns split by hairlines: Problem 1, Solution 1, Problem 2, Solution 2, where problems sit above striped textures and solutions above solid red blocks.
whatItMeans: Striped versus solid fills visualise messy versus resolved, and column rules keep the comparison tidy.
techniques: Striped texture for problems, solid block for solutions
Four columns divided by thin vertical lines

vocabulary.definition: Fine vertical lines used as a graphic fill.
A flat colour rectangle used as a contrast to texture.
